name: Konfyra Professional Portal
author: gsrcoimbatore

sections.description:
Konfyra Professional Portal transforms any WordPress site into a fully-featured practice management platform — without code, without third-party SaaS, and without monthly subscription fees.

Who is this for?

  • Coaches (life, business, executive, sports, wellness)
  • Therapists (psychotherapists, counsellors, occupational therapists)
  • Consultants (management, IT, HR, strategy)
  • Lawyers and legal professionals
  • Chartered Accountants and Tax Advisors
  • Financial Planners and Advisors
  • Architects and Designers
  • Psychologists and Mental Health professionals
  • Nutritionists and Dietitians
  • Any professional service provider

Core Features

  • Client management with self-registration
  • Bookings and appointments with status tracking
  • Service plans and subscriptions
  • Check-in tracking with time-in/time-out
  • Tracked metrics with reference ranges and trend reports
  • Six-tab reports dashboard (Overview, Bookings, Check-ins, Clients, Metrics, Revenue)
  • Native consultation rooms with live chat — no third-party service
  • 14 auto-created portal pages on activation
  • Role-based access control (Portal Client, Professional/Practitioner)
  • 16 shortcodes, 13 custom post types
  • Zero external API dependencies
sections.installation:
Note for upgraders: If you have pages using the legacy [wpp_*] shortcodes (e.g. [wpp_login], [wpp_register]), they will continue to work — back-compatibility aliases are registered automatically. New installations should use the [kfpp_*] shortcodes.

  1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Konfyra Portal → Portal Pages to verify all 14 pages were created
  4. Go to Konfyra Portal → Settings to configure currency
  5. Add professionals via the Professionals CPT
  6. Clients self-register via [kfpp_register]
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Outputs semantic HTML with BEM-style CSS classes.

Is client data stored on external servers?

No. All data stored exclusively in your WordPress database.

What happens to data if I deactivate?

Nothing. All data preserved. Reactivating restores full functionality immediately.

Does it support multisite?

Yes.

Where can I get support?

Website: https://www.konfyra.com | Contact: Ramesh Kumar G S
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • New: Professional categories, service categories, areas, product categories, accommodation types (taxonomies)
  • New: Retreat, Travel Experience, Accommodation CPTs (16 total)
  • New: [kfpp_search] AJAX search shortcode with filters by type, category, area, sort
  • Fixed: Login now uses wp_signon() — respects 2FA and security plugins
  • Fixed: Coach registration requires admin approval before login
  • Fixed: upload_files capability removed from custom roles
  • Fixed: Menu position changed to 58 (below Appearance)
  • Fixed: Generate WordPress user from backend for coaches/members
  • WP Plugin Review: all flagged issues resolved

3.0.1

  • Fixed activation fatal errors (incomplete ternary syntax in class-wpp-portal.php)
  • Fixed stable tag mismatch
  • Removed debug logger

3.0.0

  • Rebrand to Konfyra Professional Portal
  • New: Check-ins, Tracked Metrics, Metric Readings, Reports admin screens
  • New: KFP_Admin_UI shared component library
  • New: Konfyra brand design system in admin
  • New: wpp_checkin, wpp_metric, wpp_metric_value CPTs
  • New: Upgrade routine with kfp_db_version tracking
  • New: Opt-in data deletion on uninstall
